notes: v1.1.0: Create is now organised into Lyrics / Styles / Voice / Band tabs. Merlin Smart Picks choose the best tempo, key, vocal style and full-band lineup (drums, bass, guitar, piano, keys, strings, synth, 808s) from your genre, mood and lyrics — with a reason, and you can override any piece. Guitar is a real Karplus-Strong plucked-string track.
